name: Doki Doki Pretty League
original_name: ドキドキプリティリーグ
source:
In the game the player takes the role of a baseball coach of Kasumigaura high school female baseball team during a period of one year. As a coach it's needed to decide the direction of training (battling, fielding, etc.) and check each girl's progress each week. 

[Edited from [url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/D/SLPS-00756.html]psxdatacenter[/url]]
translation:
游戏中玩家扮演霞浦高中女子棒球队的棒球教练，为期一年。作为教练，需要决定训练方向（战斗、防守等）并每周检查每个女孩的进步。

[编辑自[url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/D/SLPS-00756.html]psxdatacenter[/url]]
